verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal is an online industrial-property filing service, so subscribing to events such as application status changes or Boletim publications via webhooks is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents only filing, renewal, opposition and administrative procedures, with no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event-subscription API. The llms.txt probe returned 404, confirming that no agent-oriented interface is published.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
